people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

people.name: Isaac
people.line: Son of Abraham; father of Jacob and Esau.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: I appeared to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, as God Almighty; but by my name Yahweh I was not known to them.
translations.bsb: I appeared to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob as God Almighty, but by My name the LORD I did not make Myself known to them.
translations.kjv: And I appeared unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob, by the name of God Almighty, but by my name JEHOVAH was I not known
translations.asv: and I appeared unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob, as God Almighty; but by my name Jehovah I was not known to them.
